contact.evidence_quote: “Our initial aim was to create a space where we could come together with our partner universities and share news about different current situations in each institution. There is so much we learn from each other.” comments Noora Kahra, Coordinator in TAMK International Services.

alternates.name: Krista Merikoski
alternates.evidence_quote: “The word spread, and our partners were excited to join. There were participants from Mexico, Uruguay and Russia side by side with our European partners. There were active and fruitful discussions throughout the day,” exclaimed Krista Merikoski, TAMK International Services Coordinator.
alternates.why_chosen: International relations officer. Krista Merikoski is an international services coordinator involved in organizing international partner events.

alternates.name: Mira Kauppinen
alternates.designation: International Mobility Specialist for Tampere University
alternates.evidence_quote: Mira Kauppinen, International Mobility Specialist for Tampere University, promised that the participants’ feedback will play a crucial role in designing the following Partner Day events. It seems that Partner Day will continue being an online event each year with an effort of bringing colleagues together without the need for travel. Tampere Universities community is thrilled to be hosting more and more guests each year, both virtual and physical.
alternates.why_chosen: Mobility coordinator. Mira Kauppinen is specifically designated as the International Mobility Specialist for Tampere University.
